title: Time-to-Action Analysis
insights:
Analysis of Bus Ticket Booking App Latency

This analysis covers the latency metrics for key transitions in a bus ticket booking application based on the collected dataset. The findings are categorized into several sections for clarity.

SLOWEST TRANSITION

The pair with the highest median latency is:

  • From: select_seat
  • To: payment_initiate
  • Median Latency: 131.8 seconds

This latency is outside the industry benchmark of 60-180 seconds for seat selection to payment initiation, indicating potential issues in this transition.

BOTTLENECK ANALYSIS

Upon examining the latency metrics, we observe the following:

  • bus_result to select_seat:
    • Median: 50.8 seconds
    • P90: 140.0 seconds
  • select_seat to payment_initiate:
    • Median: 131.8 seconds
    • P90: 594.1 seconds

The significant gap between the median and P90 for the transition from select_seat to payment_initiate suggests a technical bottleneck, as the P90 latency (594.1 seconds) is considerably higher than the median (131.8 seconds). This indicates that while most users experience a reasonable delay, a subset experiences significantly longer delays, likely due to UX issues or technical inefficiencies.

END-TO-END TIME

The end-to-end time from search to payment success is:

  • Median Latency: 527.0 seconds
  • Mean Latency: 1006.8 seconds

This time is considerably longer than the competitive benchmark of 3-8 minutes (180-480 seconds), indicating that the overall user flow is not competitive and requires optimization.

SPEED IMPROVEMENTS

To reduce latency, the following specific improvements are recommended:

  • Optimize Seat Selection Process: Streamline the interface and reduce loading times, aiming for a reduction of at least 30 seconds in the median latency.
  • Enhance Backend Performance: Improve server response times during the seat selection to payment initiation transition, targeting a reduction of 60 seconds in the P90 latency.
  • Implement User Guidance: Provide clearer instructions and faster navigation options to help users complete their actions more quickly, potentially saving an additional 20 seconds in the overall flow.
